name: @adaptabletools/adaptable-mcp

tools.name: check_expression
tools.description: Validates an AdapTableQL expression with the 24 engine: syntax, functions, kinds the module accepts, column references; exact rewrites for JavaScript-style operators and pre-24 syntax.

cwd.description: Project folder (absolute path); defaults to the folder the server was started in

major.description: AdapTable major to assume instead of detecting it from the project

framework.description: Framework to assume instead of detecting it

offline.description: Never touch the network; use caches and bundled snapshots

docsHost.description: Docs host to read instead of the default one

expression.description: The AdapTableQL expression; `-` reads a batch from stdin (one per line, or a JSON array)

module.description: Module the expression belongs to; applies its kinds and function availability

kind.description: Expression kind; inferred from the module and the expression when omitted

columns.description: Grid columns: a columnDefs JSON / source file or DevTools getColumns() output; enables column checks

columnsValue.description: Grid columns as a value (MCP): ColDefs or DevTools getColumns() output

file.description: Batch: a JSON array of strings or { expression, module?, kind? } objects, or one expression per line

text.description: Batch text (stdin); the CLI fills it for `-`

tools.name: migrate_expression
tools.description: Rewrites one pre-24 AdapTableQL expression to the target major's syntax with the library's own migration (brace aggregations, named operands, legacy observable rules) and validates the result.

cwd.description: Project folder (absolute path); defaults to the folder the server was started in

major.description: AdapTable major to assume instead of detecting it from the project

framework.description: Framework to assume instead of detecting it

docsHost.description: Docs host to read instead of the default one

to.description: Target major; defaults to the engine's own major (the newest)

module.description: Module the expression belongs to; picks the kinds tried and the validation rules

kind.description: Expression kind; inferred from the module and the expression when omitted (`SUM([x])` is an aggregation only in the aggregated kinds)

columns.description: Grid columns for the validation: a columnDefs JSON / source file or DevTools getColumns() output

columnsValue.description: Grid columns as a value (MCP): ColDefs or DevTools getColumns() output

instructions: AdapTable developer tooling (@adaptabletools/adaptable-mcp 1.0.0, response schema 1). Every tool returns the same envelope as the `adaptable` CLI with `--json`: `ok`, `data`, `issues`, `warnings`, `resolvedContext`, or `error { code, message, hint }`. Call `detect_environment` first so later calls run against the project's AdapTable version; pass `cwd` when the project is not the server's working directory. Workflows (setup, development, debugging, upgrades) live in the adaptable-* skills, not in this server.
